描述_EN: 1961, hanging scroll, ink and colour on paper. bibliography: rene-yvon lefebvre d'argence, 'chang dai-chien: a retrospective', center of asian art and culture, the avery brundage collection, (san francisco, 1974): chu-tsing li, 'trends in modern chinese painting', artibus asiae supplementum 37 (ascona, 1979); shen c. y. fang on behalf of zhang daqian. mrs fang was his close friend and studied painting with him. fu, challenging the past: the paintings of chang dai-chien (university of washington press, 1991). today his paintings are sought after by collectors worldwide. here the expressive broad strokes are excuted in balance with more descriptive ones. zhang daqian, mooring at the cormorant gate, datable to ca. zhang daqian is regarded as one of the greatest artists in the 20th-century china. the painting bears a poem composed and inscribed by the artist, which indicates that the painting is a memory image of the artist trip to mt huang thirty years ago. the painting was sold to the museum in 1966 by a then london-based female chinese artist mrs c.l. the landscape is typical of the artist's style in this period, just before he developed the splashed-ink-and-colour technique.
描述_ZN: 1961年，挂轴，纸本水墨和彩色。 bibliography: rene-yvon lefebvre d'argence, 'chang dai-chien: a retrospective', center of asian art and culture, the avery brundage collection, (san francisco, 1974): chu-tsing li, 'trends in modern chinese painting', artibus asiae supplementum 37 (ascona, 1979); shen c. y. 方女士代表张大千卖给博物馆。 方女士是张大千的密友，并与他一起学习绘画。 福，《挑战过去：张大千的绘画》（华盛顿大学出版社，1991）。 今天，他的画作被全世界的收藏家所追捧。 在这里，富有表现力的广泛笔触与更多的描述性笔触相平衡。 张大千，停泊在鸬鹚门前，时间约为1961年。 张大千被认为是20世纪中国最伟大的艺术家之一。 这幅画上有艺术家创作和题写的诗，这表明这幅画是艺术家三十年前去黄山的记忆画面。 这幅画是在1966年由当时在伦敦的中国女艺术家C.L.女士卖给博物馆的。 这幅山水画是艺术家在这一时期的典型风格，就在他发展出泼墨和色彩技术之前。
